2410.13380_fig_3.description: Heat-bath algorithmic cooling (HBAC) of N = 3 qubits. (a) A schematic diagram of HBAC, which consists of repeated cycles of dynamic cooling and rethermalizing the reset qubits (here, qubits q1 and q2 ) with the bath. (b) A quantum circuit implementing two round of HBAC.
